name: AnchorRead - Reading Accelerator
short_description: Bold the first part of words to read faster. Free, open source, zero tracking.
description:
AnchorRead is a free, open-source Chrome extension that helps you read faster by bolding the initial portion of each word.

HOW IT WORKS

AnchorRead creates "anchors" — visual fixation points at the start of each word — that guide your eyes smoothly through text. This technique may help improve reading speed and focus.

KEY FEATURES

• One-click toggle — Enable/disable on any page instantly
• Adjustable bold ratio — Slide between 10% and 90% to find your comfort zone
• Syllable-aware splitting — Words are split at natural syllable boundaries for more readable results
• Dynamic content — Automatically converts text loaded after page load (works with SPAs, infinite scroll, Twitter, Reddit, etc.)
• Lightweight — Zero dependencies, ~8KB total
• Privacy-first — No data collection, no network requests, no account required. Works 100% offline.

HOW TO USE

1. Click the AnchorRead icon in your toolbar
2. Toggle the switch to enable/disable
3. Drag the bold ratio slider to adjust intensity
4. Settings are saved automatically across pages

OPEN SOURCE

AnchorRead is 100% open source under the MIT license. View the source code, report issues, or contribute at: https://github.com/tianzhiceng297-boop/anchor-read

PERMISSIONS EXPLAINED

• "Read and change all your data on all websites" — Required to bold text on pages you visit. AnchorRead never sends this data anywhere; all processing happens locally in your browser.
